findings.title: Plugin completion logs no longer include the trace ID
findings.body: The previous implementation explicitly extracted `tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` and appended it as the `traceID` structured log field. The new contextual logger middleware only adds endpoint/plugin/datasource/user fields, and this call now logs only `logParams` obtained from `FromContext`, so no trace ID is added. As a result, backend plugin request completion logs cannot be correlated with traces anymore, regressing the existing observability contract. Add the trace ID to the contextual attributes or retain it in `logParams`.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to the exported Logger interface breaks downstream implementations
findings.body: `Logger` is an exported interface, and adding a required `FromContext(context.Context)` method means every existing custom implementation outside this change no longer satisfies it and will fail to compile when upgrading. This is a source-incompatible API change in addition to the middleware rename. Preserve compatibility by using a separate optional contextual-logger interface/type assertion at the call site, or provide an adapter/migration path rather than extending the existing interface.
